messages:
maya: quick heads-up 10: rolling a micro-canary for route-level sampling + routing-tag propagation at 09:30 PT. goal: validate per-route quotas and invoice-preview parity.
ajay: scope? single partition or tenant set?
maya: single partition, 6 tenants labeled sampling_v3. will route only embed-heavy and long-session routes.
sam: make sure sampling happens after tokenization to avoid chunk bias. also emit x-rw-sampled header.
leo: add telemetry: sampled_count, wiretap_count, preview_delta_pct. create dashboard card and a temporary alert at 0.5% preview_delta.
irene: UX: invoice-preview should show "estimate: sampled" badge and a confidence band. ops wants an "exclude from billing" toggle per-tenant.
billing-eng: enrich schema change needed: add sampling_factor and routing_tag. ledger transform must consume them unchanged. add acceptance test that preview vs ledger <= $0.02 for canary tenants.
ajay: dedupe caveat 12: dedupe window currently 90s. sampling may cause cross-partition duplicates if session hashes change. extend dedupe window to 5m for sampling_v3 tag during rollout.
ops-bot: dashboard created: https://console.internal.redwood/d/sampling_v3 panels ids: 5,9,14. alert rule sampling-preview-delta at 0.5%.
maya: deployment plan: 09:30 canary partition 11 for 2h; if stable expand to 4 partitions for 24h. rollback triggers: preview_delta > 0.5% or dup_pct > 0.3%.
[09:31] ops-bot: job sampling-v3-canary started (job id: job-13131).
[10:20] maya: canary live. ingest 7rps, sampled header present, wiretap topic receiving full events.
[10:50] sam: preview_delta 0.18% across cohort, no dup alert. wiretap shows original tokens for reconciliation.
[11:10] leo: small anomaly: tenant t-808 preview under by 0.7% due to mixed-request routing. fixing route selector to prefer canonical_route header.
maya: paused expansion; patch rolling.
[11:45] ops-bot: patch rolled; preview_delta back to 0.15%. resuming expansion tomorrow.
billing-eng: filed ENG-BILL-451 for adding nightly wiretap vs ledger diff job and an export for finance.
irene: follow-up UX: add tooltip on the sampled badge explaining sampling rate and link to drift report.
maya: thanks everyone. will reopen thread when we expand.
[12:05] ops-bot: job job-13131 completed: canary paused for fixes.
